title: The tensor square for homotopy single complexes
statement: Let C and D be symmetric closed monoidal Grothendieck abelian categories, with additive tensor, and let U:C→D be an additive strong monoidal left adjoint. For L,M in C let s,s′ be degree-zero cochain inclusion, q,q′ the homotopy quotients, H the termwise functor on homotopy categories, c the canonical single/termwise-U comparison, and t the explicit cochain single tensorator. Then H(q(t(L,M)));q′(c(L tensor M));q′(s′(δU(L,M))) = δH(q(sL),q(sM));(q′(cL) tensor q′(cM));q′(t(UL,UM)). There is no flatness assumption. The homotopy and tensor constructions are those of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and [def-kun-derived-tensor], and t is [lem-pur-etale-single-cochain-monoidal].

source.place: Tags 06YU and 07A4, degree-zero specialization of the termwise tensor comparison.

proof.text: Precompose the cochain equation by the inverse canonical comparison and the image under U of the inverse single tensorator, and postcompose by the inverse target tensorator. Use from_single_hom_ext. In degree zero the inverse tensorator is the (0,0) inclusion and the single/termwise comparison has identity components. The defining summand equation for mapBifunctorComparison, followed by naturality of tensor inclusions, proves this cochain equation. Apply q′, using its functoriality and identity tensorator. The definitions of mapHomotopyCategory and its oplax comparison identify the result with the stated equation.

lean.statement:
theorem singleHomotopyTensorIso_pullback
    (U : C ⥤ D) [U.Additive] [U.Monoidal] [U.IsLeftAdjoint]
    (L M : C) :
    let H := U.mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)
    let q := HomotopyCategory.quotient C (.up ℤ)
    let q' := HomotopyCategory.quotient D (.up ℤ)
    let s := HomologicalComplex.single C (.up ℤ) 0
    let s' := HomologicalComplex.single D (.up ℤ) 0
    let c := HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex U (.up ℤ) 0
    H.map (q.map (singleCochainTensorIso L M).hom) ≫
        q'.map (c.hom.app (L ⊗ M)) ≫ q'.map (s'.map (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ U L M)) =
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ H (q.obj (s.obj L)) (q.obj (s.obj M)) ≫
        (q'.map (c.hom.app L) ⊗ₘ q'.map (c.hom.app M)) ≫
        q'.map (singleCochainTensorIso (U.obj L) (U.obj M)).hom
